enabledNote: false = Core keeps Arcane Battery as the Tower faction skill; Artificing rows (graft buffs, ledger hero buffs, Transcribe) are still generated but nothing grants them. Flip to true only after the runtime has an in-game check.
graftScopeNote: A graft applies to every variant of a Tower unit line (base, upgrade, alternate upgrade), so upgrading never loses it. Change to unit_sid only with a ledger migration.

essence.source: enemy creatures lost by every losing side of a battle this hero won (started vs after TransferSide stacks, same accounting as Skeletal Necromancy)

graftCost.sourceTierRule: tier of the unit the passive was transcribed from; when the same schematic is transcribed again the lower (cheaper) tier is kept
graftCost.targetTierRule: tier of the Tower unit line receiving the graft

genericRulesNote: field=name matches the English display name, field=key the view passive key (Lang name sid without _name). Generic passives are never written into the Schematic Book. manualPayloadsNote: key -> {data?, actions?, statOverrides?, helpers?, runtime?, perUnit?, descriptionText?, note}. The only payload source: view passives are display labels that are not index-aligned with logic passive blocks. data/actions/statOverrides go on the graft buff. helpers are extra Core rows ({kind: buff|side_buff|side_buff_info|obstacle|hero_buff, row}); '{graft}' in any string expands to the graft buff sid. runtime is read by Homm3TowerArtificingRuntime (onHit, berserkOnHit, vampirism, battleStart, oncePerBattle; map grafts: heroBuff + nativeUnitSet, dailyGold; abilities). perUnit names a generator rule that writes one variant graft row per Tower unit sid. descriptionText replaces the resolved Lang description.

observationNote: Approved 2026-10-26: one roll per observed passive per battle at chanceByRank (Basic/Advanced/Expert %), both sides observable. diagnostics = log the befp attribution scope (independent of enabled; spends no rolls) up to diagnosticLogLines lines per launch.
observeOverridesNote: key -> observe specs replacing the derivation (tools/tower_artificing/observe_specs.py) where the native mechanic is not a matching passive action: auras and global passives (aura tags), hero side modifiers and unit-set hero bonuses, attack mechs, map cards (map_proxy), partial native actions.
